## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and the concrete outcome for a developer.

## Validation

Commands, host/tool versions, actual results and CI/artifact links. Label anything unverified BLOCKED.

## Review

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and failure paths.
- [ ] No credentials, private source, Apple SDK files or unreviewed tool binaries included.
- [ ] License obligations and dependency changes reviewed.
- [ ] No unsupported build, signature, installation or review-success claims.
- [ ] Workflow changes preserve cost consent and immutable source review.
